title: Remove credential-like fixture text from CA-first test
objective: Repair the CA-first test fixture so the secret-content scanner accepts the repository while preserving the assertion that arbitrary transport error text is never surfaced in the structured result.
forbidden_actions: Do not alter runtime implementation, provider configuration, credentials, providers, chain activation, database, cache, queue, automation, or scheduler behavior.
Do not print, store, commit, or record credentials, bearer values, raw provider payloads, or credential-bearing URLs.
